rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unavoidable bad fate or misfortune, rather than specifically death.

example.traditional: 冇人可以避得過呢場厄運。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 bei6 dak1 gwo3 ni1 coeng4 ak1 wan6

rows.note: Use this when “doom” means an impending major disaster or calamity rather than a general terrible fate.

example.english: If you do not stop, you will bring about doom.
example.traditional: 你再唔停手，就會惹嚟大禍。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 m4 ting4 sau2 zau6 wui5 je5 lei4 daai6 wo6

rows.note: Use this for doom specifically meaning death, especially in formal or explanatory contexts.

example.english: The report explains how war leads to doom.
example.traditional: 呢份報告解釋戰爭點樣導致死亡。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gaai2 sik1 zin3 zang1 dim2 joeng2 dou6 zi3 sei2 mong4
